principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible for maintaining order information (items, quantities, prices, and status) while also potentially handling payment processing through a method that affects the order's status. The PaymentProcessor is also directly modifying order status.
principle_violations.suggestion: The PaymentProcessor should not modify the order's status directly. Instead, make status management an explicit responsibility of the Order class, maintaining a clear separation of concerns.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
